info.title: API.SH: Nordstrom
info.description: The Nordstrom API from API.SH: public Nordstrom data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Products in a Nordstrom category or brand page, with the site's sort and filters: name, brand, price, regular price, discount, rating, review count, colors, images and link, plus the filters the page offers with the values to send back. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nordstrom-category

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Listing path, for example /browse/women/clothing/dresses or /brands/nike (a nordstrom.com link works too).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: featured, newest, price_asc, price_desc, rating or discount.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand filter value, as listed in `filters` (for example nike).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color filter value (for example black).

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: Price range in dollars (for example 50-100).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: sale
parameters.description: regular or sale.

parameters.name: discount
parameters.description: Minimum discount filter value (for example 30.0-*).

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Product type filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Length filter value (for example mini).

parameters.name: occasion
parameters.description: Occasion filter value (for example bridal).

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Material filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Style filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: fabric
parameters.description: Fabric filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: feature
parameters.description: Feature filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: closure
parameters.description: Closure filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Gender filter value: men, women, boys or girls (as listed in `filters`).

parameters.name: activity
parameters.description: Activity filter value, as listed in `filters` (for example athleisure).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of one Nordstrom product: rating, title, text, date, reviewer, helpful votes, fit and size details the reviewer gave (size, height and similar), photos, with the product's average rating, 1-5 star breakdown and size and width ratings. Returns the product page's most helpful reviews or its reviews with photos (about a dozen); `next_page` is null. Pass `q` to open the first current search result, or a product `url` or `id`. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nordstrom-reviews

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words; the first current result with reviews is used. Either q, url or id is required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Nordstrom product link (https://www.nordstrom.com/s/<slug>/<id>).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Nordstrom product id (the number at the end of a product link).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: helpful (default) or photos (reviews with photos first).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products matching a Nordstrom search, with the site's sort and filters (brand, color, price, size, sale, discount, product type, gender and more): name, brand, price, regular price, discount, rating, review count, colors, images and link, plus `filters`: every filter group the results offer, each option with its label, whether it is selected and the value to send back (the part after `filterBy...=` in `query`). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nordstrom-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand filter value, as listed in `filters` (for example nike).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color filter value (for example black).

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: Price range in dollars, as listed in `filters` (for example 0-25, 50-100).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size filter value, as listed in `filters` (for example women-s-shoes_5).

parameters.name: sale
parameters.description: regular or sale (sale: on-sale items only).

parameters.name: discount
parameters.description: Minimum discount filter value (for example 30.0-*).

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Product type filter value, as listed in `filters` (for example clothing_bras).

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Gender filter value: men, women, boys or girls (as listed in `filters`).

parameters.name: activity
parameters.description: Activity filter value, as listed in `filters` (for example athleisure).

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Length filter value (for example mini).

parameters.name: occasion
parameters.description: Occasion filter value (for example casual).

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Material filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Style filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: fabric
parameters.description: Fabric filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: feature
parameters.description: Feature filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: closure
parameters.description: Closure filter value, as listed in `filters`.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width filter value, as listed in `filters`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
